title: Chicken Piccata
description: Chicken Piccata is a classic Italian dish featuring tender pan-seared chicken breasts finished in a bright, velvety sauce made with white wine, fresh lemon juice, capers, and butter. Elegant yet simple, this restaurant-quality recipe delivers the perfect balance of richness, citrus, and briny flavors, making it an ideal choice for both casual dinners and fine dining.

ingredients.title: Chicken
items: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 6 oz each)
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
½ cup all-purpose flour, for dredging

ingredients.title: Sauce
items: ¾ cup dry white wine (e.g., Pinot Grigio)

ingredients.title: Optional Garnish
items: Lemon slices, lightly seared or fresh

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Place chicken breasts between two sheets of plastic wrap.
Gently pound to ½-inch thickness using a meat mallet, ensuring even cooking.
Season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
Lightly dredge each piece in flour, shaking off excess.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Sear the Chicken
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add chicken, cooking 3–4 minutes per side, until golden brown.
Remove chicken from the pan and keep warm on a plate covered loosely with foil.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Make the Piccata Sauce
steps: In the same pan, reduce heat to medium.
Deglaze with white wine, scraping the browned bits from the pan.
Simmer for 2–3 minutes until wine reduces slightly.
Add chicken stock, lemon juice, and capers. Simmer for 4–5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Remove from heat and whisk in cold butter pieces to create a glossy, velvety sauce. Taste and adjust seasoning.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finish the Dish
steps: Return chicken to the pan briefly to warm, coating with sauce.
Optionally, garnish with lemon slices or microgreens.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating
steps: Place chicken breast slightly off-center on a warm plate.
Spoon sauce generously over the top, ensuring capers are visible.
Add lemon slice or microgreens for color contrast.
Serve immediately, paired with risotto, angel hair pasta, or sautéed vegetables.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with creamy risotto, angel hair pasta, or buttery mashed potatoes.
Pair with sautéed seasonal vegetables or roasted asparagus.
Garnish with fresh parsley and lemon slices for an elegant presentation.

chefTips: Pound evenly: Ensures the chicken cooks uniformly without drying out.
Deglaze with wine: Adds depth and acidity; never skip it.
Finish with cold butter: Emulsifies the sauce for a silky, glossy texture.
Capers: Rinse to remove excess salt; they provide a briny punch.
Heat management: Medium-high for searing, medium for sauce to avoid burning butter.
